response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS race_name, AVG(cr.points) AS average_points, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM races AS r JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.raceId = r.raceId WHERE cr.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name), race_name_averages AS (SELECT race_name, AVG(average_points) AS name_average_points FROM per_race GROUP BY race_name) SELECT p.raceId, p.race_name, p.average_points, p.result_count, p.average_points / NULLIF(n.name_average_points, 0) AS ratio FROM per_race AS p JOIN race_name_averages AS n ON n.race_name = p.race_name ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
